Hi Claire / Legal team,

Thanks again for taking the time to demo with us today — really appreciate the thoughtful questions. Quick recap and proposed next steps on the security/compliance items we discussed: 

- SOC 2: you asked for our current status and timelines. We are SOC 2 Type II in progress; our latest assessment period covers Jan–May 2026 and the final report is expected Q3 2026.
- IAM / SSO: we support SAML 2.0 SSO (IdP-initiated and SP-initiated), SCIM v2 for user provisioning, and RBAC with tenant & role-level admin controls.
- Evidence & artifacts: I can share the SSO metadata, SCIM flow diagram, admin console screenshots, and a short SSO configuration guide.
- Vendor questionnaire: happy to start the vendor security questionnaire — please attach the spreadsheet you prefer and we'll route to our security team.

Proposed next steps:
1) Please send the vendor questionnaire (or upload to the Drive link below).
2) I will share the SSO metadata, SCIM diagram, and a short admin controls pack (see attachments).
3) If helpful, offer a 30-minute technical walkthrough with our security engineer (Neha) and one of our implementation engineers (Aditya) — propose Tue/Wed next week.

Drive link for uploads: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-example

Attached: redwood_sso_config_guide.pdf, occ_sso_metadata.xml (SSO metadata)

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the clear recap — this is helpful. A few clarifications from our side: 

- SOC 2: Vastly Health requires either a current SOC 2 Type II report or an attestation that the report is in progress and expected by a specific date. We note your expected Q3 timeline; can you confirm an estimated month?
- Vendor questionnaire: attaching our standard vendor security questionnaire (Vastly_Vendor_Questionnaire_v3.xlsx) — please have security fill in the appropriate tabs.
- For IAM, the reviewers will want:
  • SAML metadata (IdP/SP) and a short SSO configuration guide (sample screenshots)
  • SCIM provisioning details and an example of attribute mappings
  • Evidence of RBAC/admin controls (screenshots or short screencast accepted)

I attached the questionnaire. Can you provide the SSO metadata and SCIM diagram? Also, if you can indicate whether you support Just-in-Time provisioning or whether provisioning is only via SCIM, that would help.

Thanks — looking to move this forward this week if possible.
